prompts.seams:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production grayscale texture mask for a game architecture seam shader, not a presentation or scene.
Generate one square 1024 by 1024 pixel grayscale mask. Pure black background means zero effect, white to gray means seam detail. Exactly one narrow continuous vertical construction joint centered at x=50%, running uninterrupted from the TOP EDGE to the BOTTOM EDGE. It must have matching placement and approximately matching width at both vertical boundaries for longitudinal tiling. The seam core is a fine near-white line about 6–10 pixels wide on a 1024 pixel canvas, with gently irregular edges and sparse short side notches. Tiny restrained chipped-edge accents and two or three fine branching hairline fissures can extend sideways, staying within the central 18% of the canvas. A subtle gray band immediately around the line suggests edge wear. Outside that central band everything is perfectly black. Keep the first and last 10% in height simple and visually consistent, with the vertical line centered and without side branches.
Art direction: restrained stylized pale concrete/stone megastructure aging, compatible with The Witness's readable, economical environmental detail. This is a grayscale DATA MASK, not colored concrete. Even illumination, no directional light, no drop shadows, no bevel lighting, no cast shadow, no rough photographic surface noise, no masonry, no tiled wall panel, no objects or scenery, no text, no arrows, no border, no watermark. Seam layout and coloration will be generated separately in shader. The whole image is the usable square texture, no margins or inset frame.
prompts.plants:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: usable RGBA game foliage decal texture atlas, not an illustration sheet or environment screenshot.
Generate one square 2048 by 2048 pixel image with a genuinely TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND and four isolated plant-cluster assets in a precisely aligned 2 by 2 atlas. Each asset stays strictly inside its own equal square quadrant, with at least 8 percent transparent padding on ALL four sides of EACH quadrant. There are no drawn dividers, no background colors, no checkerboard, no labels, no captions, no borders. Use the full atlas as four equal cells; each plant is visually centered within its quadrant and does not overlap another cell.
TOP LEFT cell: a narrow upward-growing tuft of seam ivy, two or three thin climbing stems carrying small simple heart-shaped leaves; visibly slim and tapered.
TOP RIGHT cell: an asymmetrical compact spreading patch of climbing ivy, denser heart-shaped leaves with connected stems, a cohesive roughly triangular/diagonal silhouette and a few projecting individual leaves.
BOTTOM LEFT cell: a wall-top ivy cluster, a short dense horizontal crown across the upper part of its cell with three to five tapered trailing leafy vines hanging downward into the cell; no wall or ledge drawn.
BOTTOM RIGHT cell: a low irregular patch of short moss and tiny rounded groundcover leaves, soft uneven silhouette but crisp readable alpha, much lower and broader than the other assets.
All four are actual flat front-facing albedo CUTOUTS for projection onto pale walls, with NO host wall, NO soil slab, NO stones, NO pot, NO ground plane, NO visible backdrop. Quiet sage green, olive, muted fresh green, a few pale yellow-green new leaves. Follow The Witness-like simplified grouped leaf shapes and restrained color blocks, readable at game distance. Use gentle local color variation between leaves and very subtle leaf interior shading only; do not bake any directional sunlight, cast shadow, contact shadow, ambient-occlusion halo, black outline, realistic leaf veins or photographic noise. Keep clear individual leaf silhouettes around edges, natural connected growth and no flowers. Flat orthographic view, no perspective, no 3D presentation. Preserve a truly transparent alpha channel outside the plants.

atlas_padding_revision: Edit this existing RGBA foliage atlas only to correct atlas padding. Keep the exact four assets, their visual style, colors and transparent background. Each occupies its original quadrant of a precise equal 2 by 2 square atlas. Uniformly shrink and recenter each complete plant cluster within its own quadrant so that EVERY visible pixel of that cluster fits inside the central 72% width AND central 72% height of that quadrant: at least 14% of each quadrant must be completely transparent on all four sides. In particular pull the top-left vine away from the central horizontal boundary, pull all top-right leaves away from the center cross and right edge, and keep the bottom-right moss entirely below the middle gutter with no stray pixels. The central vertical and horizontal gutters must be completely empty transparent alpha, not black, gray or checkerboard. Do not crop any leaves. Do not add cell borders, labels, background panels, drop shadows or any new plants. Preserve real RGBA transparency. This must be a usable game texture atlas, not a presentation.
note: Requested 1024/2048 in prompts; generator returned 1254-square source files. Original pixels were preserved and not upscaled.
